name: Adullam
line: Adullam was a Canaanite royal city in Judah's lowlands, best known for the nearby cave where David took refuge and gathered his men.

moments.title: David hides in the cave
moments.text: David left Gath and took refuge in the cave of Adullam. His brothers and his father's household came down to him there.

moments.title: A band gathers around David
moments.text: People who were upset, in debt, or unhappy gathered around David, and he became their leader. About four hundred men were with him.

moments.title: Three mighty men come to David
moments.text: At harvest time, three of the thirty chief men went down to David at the cave of Adullam while Philistines were camped in the Valley of Rephaim. They later brought him water from Bethlehem, but he poured it out to the LORD.

moments.title: Rehoboam fortifies Adullam
moments.text: Rehoboam built up Adullam as one of the fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin. He put officers, supplies, shields, and spears in them.
